units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 17:19">Targ. II Sam. XVII, 19</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M01938"><he>מסך</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 3:25">Targ. Num. III, 25</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Megillah 26b:11">Meg. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>האי פְּרִיסָא וכ׳</he> (Rashi <he>פרסא</he>) to make of an old curtain (covering the ark which contains the Torah scrolls) a cover for books; a. e.—Pl. <he>פְּרָסֵי</he>.
Succ. 20ᵇ חזו לפ׳ ונפוותא are fit for covers and sieves (Ar.: for sifting nets and sieves).
